note: LATENCY 事件监控实测：本实例 latency-monitor-threshold=0（默认关闭），且 CONFIG 被 rename-command 禁用，无法在线开启

observed.LATENCY DOCTOR: I'm sorry, Dave, I can't do that. Latency monitoring is disabled in this Redis instance. You may use CONFIG SET latency-monitor-threshold <milliseconds> in order to enable it.

enable_methods: redis.conf 写入 latency-monitor-threshold 100（单位 ms）后重启
CONFIG SET latency-monitor-threshold 100（本实例因安全加固禁用 CONFIG，生产按需评估）
redis8_plus: 8.x 另有命令延迟跟踪（latency-tracking yes + latency-tracking-info-percentiles），需 CONFIG 开启，本实例未启用

diff_slowlog.SLOWLOG: 记录'命令执行超过阈值'的明细（谁、什么时候、什么命令、多少微秒），默认 10ms 开启，环形保留 128 条
diff_slowlog.LATENCY: 记录'延迟事件'的发生时间与采样直方图（command/fork/aof-write 等类别），默认关闭，适合看尖峰趋势与根因类别
